decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's established pharmaceutical range and supported by its own R&D and formulation know-how, this product is one the firm can learn about and improve rather than withdraw quickly.

Because this generic antidepressant is described as distant from the firm's established offer, the firm's absorptive capacity for interpreting weak early signals is lower here, making withdrawal more likely despite its R&D base.

This antihypertensive line is close to the firm's core knowledge, appears to have broader commitment through several models, and fits a German pharma firm's tendency to retain scalable products it can refine with in-house R&D.

Although its lighter website presence suggests a smaller launch, the supplement builds on the firm's existing self-care offer and strategic aim to grow differentiated pharmacy health products, so it is more likely to be retained than removed.
